_comment: Canonical listing store, regenerated by refresh.py. Every entry under `listings` was found by sweeping the full active MLS inventory of the target cities and then independently confirmed Active against MetroListPRO, the official MetroList MLS site. Listing status is never taken from search-engine text — see README 'Verification gate'.

dataQuality.primarySource: Coldwell Banker IDX feed (MetroList MLS data), full city inventory sweep
dataQuality.verificationSource: MetroListPRO — official MetroList MLS public search
dataQuality.note: Swept 323 active listings across the target cities; 77 passed the bed/bath/price filter and had their detail pages read for acreage and pool; 10 met every criterion; 10 of those were confirmed Active by the MLS itself.

listings.desc: Discover the property 1234 Rising Hill W Road, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Discover the perfect blend of serenity and opportunity with this exceptional Placerville estate. Situated on a total of 2.69 acres comprised of a 1.39-acre primary parcel and an additional, flat 1.3-acre parcel this property offers unparalleled potential and room to grow in one of the area's finest neighborhoods. The second parcel can be sold or developed separatley. The home needs fixing, it will not qualify for VA/FHA financing. Step inside to find a thoughtfully designed floor plan that maximizes comfort and flow. The heart of the home is a kitchen built for both utility and connection, featuring ample, easily accessible storage and a window above the primary sink that perfectly frames the arrival of family and guests. A convenient passthrough connects the kitchen to the dining room, which opens seamlessly into a spacious living area. Bathed in natural light from abundant windows and skylights, this space invites the native beauty of the outdoors inside. The main level offers effortless living, while the upstairs primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat. Wake up to serene views and step directly onto your private balcony deck overlooking the pool and barn area. For added convenience, a dedicated utility and laundry room is situated perfectly between the kitchen and the garage. The backyard is your own private getaway. Dive into the gorgeous, inground pool, complete with natural rock features and lush vegetation that create an atmosphere of total seclusion. Whether you're hosting summer gatherings or enjoying quiet evenings, the multiple decksincluding direct access from the bedroomsmake indoor-outdoor living a breeze.    Out back, a substantial barn stands ready for your projects or storage needs, complemented by a massive double carport and ample driveway parking. Nestled in a quiet, natural setting, this home puts you close to town while surrounding you with the quiet, native beauty that makes Placerville special. This is truly a rare opportunity to own a property that combines established excellence with immense potential for expansion. Schedule your visit to see the possibilities firsthand! https://photos.app.goo.gl/KBbpbysn3RFFM7BT8
listings.caveat: MLS counts 3 total baths as 2 full + 1 half — only 2 full baths.

listings.desc: Discover the property 1988 Cold Springs Road, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Beautiful farmhouse-inspired home featuring a stunning built-in pool & spa, offering the perfect blend of convenience & peaceful country living just minutes from town. This spacious property includes 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, a dedicated office or possible 5th bedroom, 2-car garage plus a detached garage/workshop, and sits on 2.73 usable acres with a year-round stream. The open-concept kitchen and dining area is ideal for hosting, highlighted by an oversized island, marble countertops, custom cabinetry, a large picture window with a cozy window seat, and abundant natural light. The main-level primary suite offers dual closets and direct access to the deck through a sliding glass door. The en-suite bathroom is designed to impress. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, a loft space perfect for relaxing, and a convenient wet bar. Work from home in comfort with an office that overlooks the pool. There's plenty of space for RV parking, recreational vehicles, animals, and more with no HOA restrictions. This property is private, versatile, and full of potential.

listings.desc: Discover the property 2565 Stagecoach Road, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Nestled on a stunning 5-acre homesite in the prestigious gated community of Greenstone Country, this custom estate blends luxury, privacy, and outdoor recreation. Surrounded by mature oak trees and rock outcroppings, the approximately 3,885 sq. ft. home is designed for comfortable living and entertaining.    The spacious floorplan offers 5-6 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, a 4-car garage, and a detached 2-car carport. Three bedrooms are located on the main level, while upstairs features the private primary suite with a balcony, fireplace, built-in storage and bar area, oversized walk-in closet with hidden storage, and two additional bedrooms.    The open-concept living area showcases Andersen wood-framed windows and patio doors, custom built-ins, and a soaring fireplace with raised hearth. The country kitchen is equipped with a new downdraft cooktop and also built in microwave/oven, dishwasher, farmhouse style sink, and a generous walk-in pantry. Hardwood and tile flooring, and brand-new carpet.  Ceiling fans, and a large laundry/mud room add comfort and convenience.    Outdoor amenities include a wraparound covered front porch, expansive back deck, fenced pool with waterfall, and covered pergola. The property also features a small olive orchard, fenced garden area with two storage sheds, and a Tuff Shed located nearby the pool area.    Residents enjoy Greenstone Country's exceptional amenities, including "The Barn" neighborhood gathering venue, riding arena, miles of horseback riding and hiking trails, fishing ponds, tennis courts, and two playgrounds.    This remarkable property offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy refined country living in one of the region's most sought-after equestrian communities!

Discover the property 3784 Cattle Drive, Shingle Springs, CA 95682 for sale. Custom Milton Estates pool home with great views! Home is situated on 5 ac of usable land with many fruit trees and endless opportunities. Features include great room concept with open spacious feel. Abundant natural light streams through windows. Well appointed kitchen with granite counter tops, Viking range and large center island. Dining area with built in lighted glass front cabinets & French door to back covered patio. Living room features pellet stove, built in cabinets and French doors to back patio. Master bedroom has built in cabinets, screened in porch to enjoy any season and prewired for a spa. Beautiful master bathroom with walk in shower, large vanity with  walk in closet. Lower level on this home is approx. 1000 sq ft (not included in sq footage) with 2 bedrooms, full bath, living area along with office. Detached workshop/garage 30 X 24, is ideal for all your toys and extra cars 1/2 bath.

listings.desc: Discover the property 3720 Four Springs Drive, Rescue, CA 95672 for sale. Sought after area. Minutes from shopping, schools.  Country living at its finest. Situated in a serene, park-like setting, this property offers unparalleled tranquility.  End of road privacy. This custom-built two story family residence offers four bedrooms, a formal dining room, separate living and family spaces, and a chef's dream kitchen, complemented by three bathrooms. Additionally, there is a three-car detached garage connected via a breezeway to the main residence. Above the garage, you'll find a versatile game room that can serve as a teen hangout or man cave, which could easily be transformed into a one-bedroom apartment complete with a full bath. The stunning built-in pool is bordered by vibrant flowers and lush greenery, enhancing the outdoor experience. From the property, enjoy distant views of Sacramento and the spectacular fireworks displays during the Fourth of July celebrations. The home is set on nearly six acres, featuring fenced areas, a loafing shed, and various other structures.

Discover the property 5551 Saddlehorn Road, Shingle Springs, CA 95682 for sale. Just minutes from town yet worlds away, this 10 acre sanctuary delivers the ultimate retreat lifestyle. Step inside to discover a beautifully updated home with 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, and an inviting upstairs game room complete with a wet bar  perfect for gatherings. The renovated kitchen shines with quartz counters, stainless appliances, and beautiful white cabinetry, flowing seamlessly into the family room with soaring ceilings, a warm woodstove, and expansive slider that frames the tranquil outdoors.    The master suite is designed for pure relaxation, featuring a spa inspired walk in shower and dual vanities. Wide plank hardwood floors, fresh baseboards, leased solar system and a whole house generator elevate comfort and peace of mind.     Outside, the resort style backyard awaits with a sparkling pool, spa, waterfall feature, and gazebo boasting a full outdoor kitchen. With 10 sprawling acres, the possibilities are endless  from agricultural pursuits to equestrian living. This is the best of both worlds: privacy, beauty, and convenience.

listings.desc: Discover the property 3565 Farview Court, Rescue, CA 95672 for sale. Perched at the end of a private court on its own private road, this fully remodeled custom hilltop estate offers breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views stretching across Folsom Lake, Bass Lake, the Sutter Buttes, Sierras and sparkling city lights. Designed to embrace its spectacular surroundings, every room showcases incredible vistas through windows and private sliding glass doors. This exceptional home offers 4-6 bedrooms and 4 full bathrooms, with nearly every bedroom featuring direct access to brand-new-multi-level balconies, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. The completely remodeled kitchen features new appliances and opens to light-filled living spaces finished new wood flooring, doors, baseboards, lighting and premium thoughtful finishes throughout. Enjoy the convenience of a fully integrated smart home system controlled by Aqua link, making it easy to manage your home's features from anywhere. The attached guest house, pool house, or private office provides outstanding flexibility with a full bathroom, space for a future kitchenette, storage area and beautiful views overlooking the pool and dramatic granite outcroppings- ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or working from home.  Step outside to a beautifully landscaped grounds featuring a fully fenced perimeter, providing privacy and security for pets and children. Relax by the pool equipped with a new Aztec solar heating system, or retreat to the newly built Eagle's Nest viewing deck-the perfect place to enjoy sunrise coffee, sunset cocktails, or peaceful evenings under the stars. A detached storage shed offers additional space for workshop, hobby room, or extra storage.  Car enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers will appreciate 3-car garage, 2 parking areas with convenient access, and room to allow for RV and boat parking if desired. There is also ample space to build an additional dwelling unit (ADU) if desired.   Despite its private mountaintop setting, the remarkable property is just minutes from Highway 50, El Dorado hills, Folsom, shopping, dining, coffee shops, and everyday conveniences. Offering unmatched privacy luxurious updates, incredible flexibility, and unforgettable views in every direction, this is a rare opportunity to own one of the area's most extraordinary homes.

Discover the property 3033 Ridgeline Drive, Rescue, CA 95672 for sale. Welcome to a residence where privacy, luxury, and energy efficiency come together in one exceptional property. Nestled in a gated community on five peaceful acres, this beautifully updated home offers the serenity of country living with the convenience of El Dorado Hills' premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and top-rated schools just minutes away.    Designed for the way Californians want to live today, this home features a fully owned solar system, two Tesla Powerwall backup batteries, Tesla EV charger, well, and septic system delivering very low cost electricity costs, energy independence, and peace of mind.    Inside, more than 3,200 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space is filled with natural light and enhanced by new luxury vinyl plank flooring, spacious gathering areas, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Whether hosting family and friends or enjoying a quiet evening at home, every space is designed for comfort and connection.    Step outside to your own private retreat where a custom pool, expansive entertaining deck, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting to unwind. Here, you'll enjoy the rare luxury of feeling miles away from it all while remaining just minutes from the restaurants, boutiques, and everyday conveniences of El Dorado Hills.    Move-in ready and loaded with valuable upgrades, this is more than a beautiful home, it's a lifestyle defined by privacy, comfort, and exceptional long-term value.

listings.desc: Discover the property 6881 Sagittarius Drive, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Crafted as the builder's own residence, this extraordinary European Country-inspired estate was designed without compromise. From its commanding setting on 40 acres with sweeping Sierra foothill views and timeless architectural details, every aspect of the property reflects quality and enduring elegance. From the moment you arrive, the home makes a striking impression, thoughtfully designed to frame a dramatic sightline through the grand entry and expansive rear windows to the rolling hills and panoramic vistas beyond. Upon entering, the soaring ceilings, custom finishes, and walls of windows create a warm, yet elegant atmosphere filled with natural light. The thoughtfully designed kitchen features granite countertops, custom cabinetry, a center island, double warming ovens, premium appliances, a walk-in pantry and picturesque views that elevate everyday living. Multiple living and dining spaces provide exceptional flexibility for entertaining, while the dedicated movie theater room brings the cinematic experience to the comfort of home. The spacious primary suite serves as a private retreat with balcony access, breathtaking views on the first floor, a spa-inspired bathroom, oversized walk-in shower, soaking tub and expansive vanity area. Two additional ensuite bedrooms offer comfort and privacy for guests or multigenerational living. 22KW Whole House Generator. Step outside to your private resort-style backyard with an artistic hand carved rock, saltwater pool specially designed to mimic local river watering holes with a rock waterfall, surrounded by blooming flowers, mature landscaping and several fruit trees creating a peaceful and picturesque retreat. Expansive outdoor entertaining areas overlook majestic oak trees and the surrounding countryside, providing the perfect setting for both quiet relaxation and memorable gatherings. Additional highlights include a 3-car drive-through garage, approximately 1,500 square feet of potential ADU or multigenerational living space on the lower level and endless opportunities for recreation, horses, vineyards or creating the ultimate private estate. This is a rare opportunity to own a custom luxury residence where timeless architecture, exceptional craftsmanship, panoramic views and peaceful acreage come together just minutes from historic Placerville, shopping, dining and convenient access to Sacramento, Lake Tahoe, and the Bay Area.

Discover the property 1781 Springvale Road, Placerville, CA 95667 for sale. Exceptional opportunity to create a luxury short-term rental, wedding venue, event center, or private multigenerational estate. There is a potential 18.5% pro forma cap rate (refer to the attached OM) This fully remodeled 10-acre property features three separate residences, including a main home and two detached guest suites, with accommodations for up to 16 guests. The centerpiece of the property is an extraordinary 150,000-gallon swimming pool, one of the largest residential pools in the county. Adjacent to the pool is a dedicated bathroom, making it ideal for entertaining, private events, and weddings. The expansive grounds offer endless possibilities for outdoor ceremonies, receptions, and gatherings. A large barn provides additional flexibility and can be converted into guest accommodations, an entertainment space, a bar, a workshop, or continue to serve as storage. A substantial solar system helps reduce operating costs while complementing the property's sustainable design. Whether you're looking to build a thriving hospitality business or enjoy a private estate with income-producing potential, this unique property offers exceptional versatility. The expansive 10 acres create a peaceful retreat while still providing convenient access to hiking, biking, fishing, nearby parks, and Red Hawk Casino.
